annotations.title: Estimate a commercial mortgage prepayment penalty

description: Estimate the prepayment premium on a commercial mortgage: Fannie Mae-style yield maintenance (Form 6104.01, annual discounting), Freddie Mac yield maintenance (monthly), CMBS yield maintenance, a defeasance cost estimate, a Fannie Mae declining (step-down) schedule, or an SBA 504 debenture premium. Treasury yields default to today's readings, interpolated to the time left. Same math as the site's prepayment calculator; schedules and minimums come from the verified loan-document facts.

amortization_years.description: For CMBS yield maintenance and defeasance: amortization in years; 0 = interest only (default).

balance.description: Principal being prepaid (or the debenture balance), in dollars.

custom_schedule.description: For step_down with schedule custom: percent of balance by loan year, e.g. [5, 4, 3, 2, 1].

debenture_years.description: For sba_504: debenture term in years.

fixed_costs.description: For defeasance: legal, accountant, rating agency and servicer costs in dollars to add (default 0).

loan_year.description: For step_down and sba_504: the loan (or debenture) year of the prepayment, 1 = first year.

method.description: Which prepayment provision the note has.

months_remaining.description: Months from the prepayment date to the end of the yield maintenance period (Fannie/Freddie) or to the open date or maturity (CMBS, defeasance).

note_rate_pct.description: Note rate in percent (for sba_504, the debenture rate). Required except for step_down.

schedule.description: For step_down: a Fannie Mae declining schedule, or custom with custom_schedule.

treasury_yield_pct.description: Treasury yield to discount at, in percent. Default: today's 5/7/10-year Treasury interpolated to months_remaining.
